text:
**Best overall: Jackery Solar Generator 1000 v2 with 200W solar panel, $699** (list $879)
It has a 1,070Wh LiFePO4 battery, 1,500W AC output, and a 1-hour fast charge. It's rated 4.5 stars across 1.4K reviews, and Amazon marks it as the "Overall Pick" for this search. A review site also picked it as its editor's choice, citing 4,000+ cycles and a weight of 23.8 lbs. That site notes that the panel may ship separately, and that the 1-hour charge needs app activation. Real-world solar charging is about 6-8 hours in full sun.
[Buy on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels-included/s?k=solar+generator+with+panels+included) (this is Amazon's search results page, so look for the Jackery 1000 v2 listing)

**Other good picks by need**

- **Similar size, other brands, $699 each:**
  - [EcoFlow Delta 3 Classic with 220W panel](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels/s?k=solar+generator+with+solar+panels): 1,024Wh, 1,800W, 4.6 stars (404 reviews).
  - [BLUETTI Elite 100 V2 with 200W panel](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels/s?k=solar+generator+with+solar+panels): 1,024Wh, 1,800W, 4.5 stars (1.8K reviews).
- **Home backup (about 2 kWh):**
  - [Jackery Explorer 2000 v2 with 2x200W panels](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels-included/s?k=solar+generator+with+panels+included): $1,399, 2,042Wh, 2,200W, 4.6 stars.
  - [BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 with 2x200W panels](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels/s?k=solar+generator+with+solar+panels): $1,399, 2,073.6Wh, 2,600W, 4.7 stars.
- **Large capacity (3 kWh+):**
  - [BLUETTI Elite 300 with 2x200W panels](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels/s?k=solar+generator+with+solar+panels): $1,599.99, 3,014Wh, 4.7 stars.
  - [Jackery HomePower 3000 with 2x200W panels](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels-included/s?k=solar+generator+with+panels+included): $1,799, 3,072Wh.
- **Costco members:** [Jackery Explorer 1500 v2 with panel](https://www.costco.com/home-solar-power.html) is $899.99 online. It was out of stock at the Mountain View warehouse, so check availability near you.
- **Budget:** [UDPOWER S1200 with 120W panel](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels-included/s?k=solar+generator+with+panels+included) is $549.99 for 1,190Wh. It has only 41 reviews at 4.1 stars, so it's less proven.

**How to choose**
- For camping, RV trips, or short outages, the Jackery 1000 v2 is the best balance. It will run a fridge for roughly 7-8 hours, according to one review.
- For longer outages or running several appliances, step up to the 2 kWh or larger class.
- Prices are from the search listings and change often, so confirm the price and what's in the box before you buy.

Sources: [Amazon (panels included)](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels-included/s?k=solar+generator+with+panels+included), [Amazon (solar panels)](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels/s?k=solar+generator+with+solar+panels), [Costco](https://www.costco.com/home-solar-power.html), [Talk of the House review](https://www.talkofthehouse.com/best-solar-generator-kits-with-panels/)

If you tell me what you'd power and your budget, I can narrow this to one pick.
